members.item: Rocky Helmet / Shed Shell / Shuca Berry

moves: Rapid Spin - The nuance behind this move will vary on a game-by-game basis. It should only really be clicked if they set up spikes, although you should still consider rapid spinning against stealth rock if you want to bring Probopass back into the game later.
Pain Split - Combined with the poisoning from toxic spikes, pain split should only take a few turns to kill an enemy pokemon.
Volt Switch  - Brings any other pokemon in safely thanks to Probopass's abysmal speed stat.
Endure - In an ideal world, endure will allow probopass to survive stealth rock damage and activate its berry juice.
Endeavor - Brings the enemy pokemon down to what is essentially 1hp.
Fake Out - Recovers stealth rock damage.
Spiky Shield - Stalls for poison damage and synergises well with endeavor (it will kill any pokemon that use a contact move).
Nuzzle - If spiky shield doesn't work and you want to stay in, nuzzle might be able to do the job. 100% chance for paralysis allows it to status any pokemon immune to poison damage as well.
Substitute - Stalls for poison damage and synergises well with Zygarde's ability power construct.
Dragon Tail - Counters other phazers and has the potential to spread toxic spikes damage.
Pursuit - Removes ghost pokemon like Mega Gengar who are immune to endeavor.
Rock Tomb - Damaging move, the additional speed drop makes it more likely for the enemy pokemon to switch; thus granting us momentum.
Trick Room - Synergy with the whole team, all of whom are fairly slow.
